name: Hive 1.16.0
notes: Security: relay sync now uploads only the connected room's own workspace (v1.0.0 to v1.15.1 also uploaded other local workspaces, encrypted under that room's key) and purges foreign events locally once; upgrade all devices. Features: phone remote access through an end-to-end encrypted relay tunnel, host dashboards, push, proposal collaboration and @hive from the phone. Fixes: presence-based host liveness, single hand-off replies, relay envelope paging.
